instruction: Candid photographic medium shot of a cozy living room at night. On the left, the woman with short gray hair (R1) in a yellow shirt and beige vest slow-dances, smiling up at the man with glasses (R2) on the right, who wears a brown jacket and smiles back. They face each other, holding hands intimately. In the blurry foreground, two glasses of white wine sit on a table. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene.
